detail.title: Epistemic Deference and Accuracy in Consensus Models
detail.summary: This research analyzes the trade-offs between preemption and total evidence views in epistemic authority, proposing that accuracy-based deference models offer a more robust framework for handling disagreements.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence on epistemic deference to address the project's core question regarding independent judgment.
